text:
[Council File 26-0964; CD 15]
Motion (McOsker - Lee) relative to adding certain street segments as roadways where it is unlawful to drive vehicles exceeding a maximum gross weight of 6,000 pounds.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For:
Watts Neighborhood Council
summary: Designate certain street segments in Council District 15 as roadways where vehicles exceeding 6,000 pounds gross weight are prohibited.

outcome.text: Transportation Committee approved item(s) (Sep 16, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 2, 2026)
